> Stay Connected

#### •   Does Chartered Accountants Ireland have regional societies and how do I join them?

Yes, Chartered Accountants Ireland have nine district societies and a number of regional and overseas chapters. Please visit the District Society page on the Chartered Accountants Ireland website for more information. 

Information for overseas members can be found here.

#### •   How do I sign up to the regional and overseas society mailing lists?

You will be automatically allocated to your local district society based on your geographical location and will receive communications from that society. We also encourage you also to sign up to Chartered Accountants Ireland social channels.

#### •   Who do I contact with any queries in relation to Chartered Accountants Ireland District Societies?

Please contact Gillian.Duffy@charteredaccountants.ie

#### •   What social media channels does Chartered Accountants Ireland have?

You can connect with Chartered Accountants Ireland on the following social media platforms:

- LinkedIn
- Facebook
- Twitter (X)
- YouTube
- Instagram
- TikTok

•   Chartered Accountants Worldwide

Chartered Accountants Worldwide bring together the leading institutes of Chartered Accountants from around the world to support, develop and promote the vital role that Chartered Accountants play throughout the global economy.
